package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/position"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// PositionHandler exposes position endpoints.
type PositionHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  position.CreatePosition
	GetUC     position.GetPosition
	UpdateUC  position.UpdatePosition
	DeleteUC  position.DeletePosition
	ListUC    position.ListPositions
}

type createPositionRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name" validate:"required,oneof=frontend backend fullstach"`
}

// Create handles POST /position/create.
func (h PositionHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req createPositionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}

	positionEntity, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), position.CreatePositionInput{Name: req.Name})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	positionEntity.TechIDs = []int{}
	positionEntity.CourseIDs = []string{}
	positionEntity.Techs = []domain.Tech{}
	positionEntity.Courses = []domain.CoursePreview{}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"position": buildPositionItem(positionEntity, queryfields.Parse("", queryfields.PositionAllowedFields))})
}

// Get handles GET /position/get/{positionID}.
func (h PositionHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "positionID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "positionID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	positionEntity, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), parsedID, resolvePositionLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language")), positionOnlyActiveCourses(r.Context()))
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	fields := queryfields.Parse(r.URL.Query().Get("fields"), queryfields.PositionAllowedFields)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"position": buildPositionItem(positionEntity, fields)})
}

type updatePositionRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name" validate:"required,oneof=frontend backend fullstach"`
}

// Update handles PUT /position/update/{positionID}.
func (h PositionHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "positionID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "positionID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var req updatePositionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}

	positionEntity, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), position.UpdatePositionInput{ID: parsedID, Name: req.Name})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	positionEntity.TechIDs = []int{}
	positionEntity.CourseIDs = []string{}
	positionEntity.Techs = []domain.Tech{}
	positionEntity.Courses = []domain.CoursePreview{}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"position": buildPositionItem(positionEntity, queryfields.Parse("", queryfields.PositionAllowedFields))})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /position/delete/{positionID}.
func (h PositionHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "positionID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "positionID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), parsedID); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// List handles GET /position/list.
func (h PositionHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	fields := queryfields.Parse(r.URL.Query().Get("fields"), queryfields.PositionAllowedFields)
	filters, err := parsers.ParsePositionFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	positions, total, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), resolvePositionLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language")), filters, positionOnlyActiveCourses(r.Context()))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if positions == nil {
		positions = []domain.Position{}
	}

	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(positions))
	for _, positionEntity := range positions {
		items = append(items, buildPositionItem(positionEntity, fields))
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"positions": items,
		"meta":      buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}

func buildPositionItem(position domain.Position, fields queryfields.Set) map[string]any {
	item := map[string]any{}
	if fields.Has("id") {
		item["id"] = position.ID
	}
	if fields.Has("name") {
		item["name"] = position.Name
	}
	if fields.Has("tech_ids") {
		techIDs := position.TechIDs
		if techIDs == nil {
			techIDs = []int{}
		}
		item["tech_ids"] = techIDs
	}
	if fields.Has("course_ids") {
		courseIDs := position.CourseIDs
		if courseIDs == nil {
			courseIDs = []string{}
		}
		item["course_ids"] = courseIDs
	}
	if fields.Has("techs") {
		techs := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(position.Techs))
		for _, tech := range position.Techs {
			techs = append(techs, map[string]any{
				"id":         tech.ID,
				"label":      tech.Label,
				"created_at": tech.CreatedAt,
			})
		}
		item["techs"] = techs
	}
	if fields.Has("courses") {
		courses := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(position.Courses))
		for _, course := range position.Courses {
			courses = append(courses, map[string]any{
				"id":          course.ID,
				"slug":        course.Slug,
				"title":       course.Title,
				"description": course.Description,
			})
		}
		item["courses"] = courses
	}
	return item
}

func positionOnlyActiveCourses(ctx context.Context) bool {
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok {
		return true
	}
	return !isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
}

func isPositionPrivilegedRole(role string) bool {
	switch strings.ToUpper(role) {
	case "ADMIN", "MODERATOR", "TEACHER":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func resolvePositionLang(header string) string {
	if header == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(header, ",")
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	lang := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
	if len(lang) >= 2 {
		return strings.ToLower(lang[:2])
	}
	return ""
}
